title: A flaw has been found in itsourcecode E-Logbook with Health Monitoring System 1.0. (CVE-2026-134568)
description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in itsourcecode E-Logbook with Health Monitoring System 1.0 in the log_keeper.php file. The flaw is triggered by manipulation of the pid argument and can be exploited remotely. Exploit code has been published, indicating potential risk of exploitation. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.3, reflecting medium severity.
